content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_of_Default
content_blocks.text: You are hereby notified that you have breached the terms of your lease agreement by failing to pay rent as required.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Time_to_Cure
content_blocks.text: You have thirty (30) days from the date of this notice to cure the default and restore compliance with the terms of the lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Consequences_of_Non-Cure
content_blocks.text: If you fail to cure the default within the time specified, this notice constitutes a demand for immediate possession of the premises and will result in the commencement of an action for eviction.
